stories.title: Define EvaluateCare Facade Input/Output Contracts
stories.description: Establish explicit request and response schemas for evaluate_care_facade methods, aligning with clinical_trials_models and provider input expectations to ensure consistent structured outputs for downstream tool usage.

stories.title: Implement Facade-Level Error Handling and Fallbacks
stories.description: Add standardized error handling within evaluate_care_facade to gracefully manage failures from clinical trials and provider detail services, including partial responses and safe fallback messaging.

stories.title: Normalize and Format Facade Responses
stories.description: Implement response normalization logic in evaluate_care_facade to ensure consistent formatting of clinical trial results and provider details, including location, distance, and link structures.

stories.title: Expose EvaluateCare Facade via FastAPI Endpoint
stories.description: Wire evaluate_care_facade into FastAPI main application as callable endpoints (or internal handlers) to support direct invocation paths in addition to tool_router flows.
